top_signals.title: Two-Year Yields Jump on Warsh’s Inflation Pledge: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders sent short-dated notes lower after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh vowed to bring inflation to the 2% target, boosting wagers on an interest-rate hike this year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Analysis: Kevin Warsh sharpens inflation warning at Jackson Hole, signaling possible rate hike
top_signals.summary: After confusing markets at his July press conference, Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh used Jackson Hole to give a clearer view of the case for higher interest rates.

top_signals.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
top_signals.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
